# Etalas Hospitality

> Etalas (PT. Etalas Karya Internasional) is Indonesia's #1 hospitality specialist software house. We build custom AI-powered operational systems for hotel groups, resorts, and hospitality enterprises — trusted by AYANA Resort Bali and Swiss-Belhotel.

Etalas serves hospitality clients across Indonesia and globally, with offices in Jakarta (Gedung Artha Graha, SCBD) and Middletown, Delaware. Primary contact: hello@etalas.com.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://hospitality.etalas.com/): Hospitality software house overview — services, process, and client work.

## Services

- Hotel management software
- Hotel operations system
- PMS integration (Opera, Mews, Cloudbeds)
- ERP integration (Xero, SAP, Oracle POS)
- AI-powered hotel workflows
- Back-of-house automation
- Custom hospitality software development
- Product design for hospitality

## Client Experience

- AYANA Resort Bali — back-of-house hotel operations platform running in daily production
- Swiss-Belhotel — enterprise hospitality systems
